description: The file 'MicrometerBasedMetrics.java' contains a Java implementation of a metrics monitoring class that uses the Micrometer library to gather and report various system and tenant-specific metrics within the context of Eclipse Hono. It includes functionality for tracking connections, message payloads, telemetry, commands, and tenant timeouts, integrating with Vert.x and Spring frameworks.

classes.name: MicrometerBasedMetrics
classes.description: A class providing micrometer-based metrics implementation for monitoring tenant connections, message payloads, telemetry, commands, and tenant timeouts within the Eclipse Hono framework, integrating with Vert.x for asynchronous timeout handling.
